title: Committed blind-hunter.md asserts a live blocker that this same commit fixes, with no resolution banner
evidence:
+1. **Blocker — `.gitignore:31` — `form_stepper.js` is git-ignored; the feature never ships.**
+!server/priv/static/form_stepper.js
detail: The committed report asserts a present-tense blocker that this commit's own .gitignore hunk fixes. diff.txt in the same directory carries a frozen/resolved banner; blind-hunter.md and edge-hunter.md do not, so they read as current findings.
recommended_fix: Add the same 'r0 snapshot — fixed in the shipped branch' header to blind-hunter.md and edge-hunter.md so the committed artifacts cannot be misread as open findings.

title: Spec frontmatter says review_loop_iteration: 0 while the same commit records a completed r0-to-r1 review loop
evidence:
+review_loop_iteration: 0
+# r0 REVIEW SNAPSHOT — frozen at sha a8b2cf9 (2026-08-01, pre-r1-fixes)
detail: The spec ships status done with review_loop_iteration 0, yet this commit freezes an r0 review snapshot and records Perkins r1 fixes (rc1-2, r1 B2, r1 W1). The counter was never advanced to match the loop the artifacts document.
recommended_fix: Bump review_loop_iteration to the actual completed iteration (or drop the field) so the spec of record reflects the review history it sits alongside.

title: New 477-line test suite requires form_stepper.js, but no hunk in this chunk adds or updates that module
detail: Tests exercise exports (shouldActivate, resolveAnchorTarget, formJsRan, shouldHoldForPreflight, hasServerMessage, resolveGatingMessage, focusTargetFor, stepChangeDetail, stepperOffInSearch) that appear in no hunk here; the only in-chunk module copy is the stale r0 snapshot lacking them. Presumably a sibling chunk — unverifiable from this one.
recommended_fix: Confirm server/priv/static/form_stepper.js with the tested exports is committed in a sibling hunk; if it is not, node --test fails MODULE_NOT_FOUND and the .gitignore whitelist alone ships nothing.

title: Unowned, unresolved bug-hunt staleness buried inside a RESOLVED deferred-work entry
evidence: +  summary: RESOLVED by rc1-2 (merged 4e7c3c9) — the attestation card renders the mandatory `reference_contact_choice` radios, and rc1-2's own PR swept the bug-hunt landing/workflow scenarios; form-bug-hunt's SKILL.md convention (PR #561) now drives the card radio. Remaining pre-existing staleness (unowned): apply-form-label-invariants' empty-submit step clicks a consent-disabled submit button (needs force_submit or consent tick).
detail: The file exists to track real unfixed work, yet the one genuinely unfixed item here is tucked inside an entry headlined RESOLVED with no owner — anyone scanning the deferred list for open items will skip it.
recommended_fix: Split the label-invariants empty-submit staleness into its own deferred-work entry with source_spec, summary, and evidence so it stays tracked.

title: Claim that the bare-directory node --test form fails MODULE_NOT_FOUND on Node 22 is dubious and duplicated in two headers
evidence:
+// `node --test scripts/js-tests/*.test.js` (wired into `make test` as test-js;
+// the bare directory form fails MODULE_NOT_FOUND on the repo's Node 22).
detail: Node 22's test runner supports directory arguments, so the committed rationale for the glob form reads like a misdiagnosis. It is repeated verbatim in both test-file headers and will steer future readers away from a working invocation.
recommended_fix: Reproduce the claimed failure and document the actual cause, or correct the comment to state the real reason the glob form is used; keep both headers consistent.
